title.narrative: Fourth Greater Mekong Subregion Corridor Towns Development Project

description.narrative: The project will improve urban services and enhance regional economic connectivity in provincial capital towns of Kampong Cham, Kratie, and Stung Treng along the Greater Mekong Subregion (GMS) Central Corridor in Cambodia. The project will finance key urban environmental infrastructure and enhance institutional effectiveness with a focus on private sector engagement and information and communication technology-based public management systems, and the policy and planning environment for regional economic connectivity.

Grant 0592: 97% of contracts awarded and 89% disbursed as of 17 Jul 2025
Grant 0593: 99% of contracts awarded and 75% disbursed as of 17 Jul 2025
Loan 3686: 88% of contracts awarded and 57% disbursed as of 17 Jul 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Kratie, Stung Treng and Kampong Cham solid waste management as well as Kampong Cham and Stung Treng wastewater and drainage contracts were already awarded. Kratie and Stung Treng landfills were already completed and have been in operation since early April 2024, 2 July 2024, respectively. Kampong Cham landfill has been completed and under defect liability period and aslo in operation since February 2025. For the other awarded packages, construction is ongoing. Under Output 2, implementation of activities is ongoing with support from Project Management Consultant and ICT-based public management system consultant.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50099/50099-002-apfs-en_4.pdf

Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Oct 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50099/50099-002-rp-en_11.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Mar 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50099/50099-002-sddr-en_6.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Mar 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50099/50099-002-smr-en_18.pdf
